name: Azurin
printedArtCredit: Mark Poole, female and male Azurin illustration, p. 8.
sourceDistinctions: Azurins retain the 1st-level bonus feat. The racial traits grant a permanent extra essentia point and do not grant human bonus skill points.
Soulborn meldshaping starts at 4th level and class essentia starts at 6th. Race and feats can give earlier essentia.
Incarnum feat investments are set for 24 hours. Midnight Dodge can change the designated opponent each turn without changing its investment.
The published examples are a Warrior, Cleric, and Soulborn. Both staged NPCs are original.
portraitForm: Lysa Vale, an original Azurin Soulborn
